'''Karim Jetha LS''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Karim Jetha]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-15827">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15827 DeckTech post 15827], DeckTech (Karim "kjedi" Jetha, 8 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15827/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15827/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Karim Jetha]]
* '''Published:''' 8 May 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 S Jetha LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Insane deck that surprises people with insane surpriseassults.

== Original post ==

'''Surprise  @#$%'''
* '''Author:''' Karim "kjedi" Jetha
* '''Published:''' May 8, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Insane deck that surprises people with insane surpriseassults.

=== Strategy ===

This deck is easy to play.

Surprise Assult, Odds, and AFAs

If you want to play it, go for it.  But don't give me @#$% because there's no strategy.  It's on dt for my reference.

(and it's worked.  beat a guy by 30-some at state)
